name: Click N’ Jump
author: Talay

sections.description:
Elementor hides the WordPress toolbar, so getting from the editor to other parts of your site and back normally means several clicks through menus.

Click N’ Jump adds two things, free and with no limits:

  1. A Navigator button inside the Elementor editor. A small button at the bottom-left of the editor opens a short menu: Dashboard, Customize (Site Editor on block themes), SEO and Posts. Drag the button anywhere; it remembers its position.
  2. A “Back to Elementor” button in the WordPress admin toolbar, and inside the Customizer. After you leave the editor, one click returns you to the page or template you were last editing. In the Customizer the button is draggable, so you can move it out of the way; it remembers its position.

The SEO shortcut opens the settings of Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress, whichever is active. It is hidden if none is found.

Good to know:

  • Links are ordinary links. Ctrl/Cmd-click opens them in a new tab, so you can keep the editor open.
  • Your work is saved first. When you pick a Navigator shortcut, the plugin asks Elementor to autosave, then leaves without the “unsaved changes” prompt. The autosave is Elementor’s draft copy, so a published page does not change until you click Update. If the save fails or takes longer than 8 seconds, you leave anyway and Elementor shows its usual prompt, so nothing is lost silently. Ctrl/Cmd-click opens a new tab and does not save.
  • Each user only sees places their WordPress role may open.
  • No external requests, tracking, accounts or license keys. No WordPress, Elementor or other plugin file is modified.
  • Without Elementor active the plugin does nothing.
  • Developers can add or change shortcuts with the cnjump_destinations and cnjump_enabled_destinations filters, add settings rows with the cnjump_settings_rows action, and add a label next to the settings title with the cnjump_settings_title action.

Support the project

The free plugin stays free. If it saves you time, you can support it at https://ko-fi.com/plugshop

Elementor is a trademark of Elementor Ltd. This plugin is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd.

Privacy and removal

The plugin stores its settings and, per user, the ID of the last document opened in the Elementor editor. Nothing is sent anywhere. Deactivation keeps this data. Deleting the plugin keeps it too, unless you tick “Delete all Navigator data when the plugin is deleted” in Settings > Click N’ Jump and save before deleting. Only this plugin’s own records are removed. On multisite, settings are per site.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and choose the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open any page with Elementor. The Navigator button appears at the bottom-left.
  4. Optional: Settings > Click N’ Jump to choose the shortcuts.
sections.faq:
The button covers something in the editor.

Drag it to another spot. The position is remembered in your browser.

The “Back to Elementor” button in the Customizer covers something.

Drag it to another spot. The position is remembered in your browser.

“Back to Elementor” does not show.

It appears after you have opened a page or template in the Elementor editor at least once, and only for pages you can still edit. It can be switched off in Settings > Click N’ Jump.

The SEO shortcut is missing.

It needs Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress to be active.
sections.changelog:
4.5.2

  • Fixed: after the autosave the “Leave site?” prompt could still appear in the Elementor editor. Shortcuts now leave without it once the page is saved.

4.5.1

  • New: the author name in the Plugins list now links to the author page.

4.5.0

  • New: shortcuts autosave the page through Elementor before leaving the editor and skip the “unsaved changes” prompt. If saving fails, the prompt still appears.
  • New: the “Back to Elementor” button in the Customizer can be dragged anywhere and remembers its position.

4.4.0

  • First public release.
